items.name: Silicone test lead wire, 18 AWG, 50 ft, black
items.use: Unterminated 50 ft reel of 18 AWG silicone lead wire for building custom-length test leads or jumpers. CAT III applies only if every part of the finished lead (plugs, clips) is also CAT III-rated; the MDP and 1825 plugs in this list are not.
items.rating: 10,000 VDC / 20 A, hands-free testing in a controlled voltage environment only. Not for handheld use above 30 Vrms / 42.2 Vpk / 60 Vdc or above 8 A. Datasheet says the wire will comply with CAT III, IEC 61010-031 when correctly terminated with other CAT III-rated parts. The wire alone is not a CAT-rated test lead, and no CAT voltage is stated.
items.notes: Official page covers both 6733-0 (black) and 6733-2 (red). 192×41 bare copper, dual-extruded silicone with white wear indicator, OD 0.144 in (3.60 mm), −50 to +150 °C.
field_notes: Bare wire only. It is not a CAT-rated lead until every plug and clip on it is CAT III-rated too.
Don't hold a lead made from it on live parts above 30 Vrms / 42.2 Vpk / 60 Vdc or 8 A.
The 10,000 VDC figure is hands-free only, in a controlled test setup. It is not a rating for energized power gear.

items.name: Silicone test lead wire, 18 AWG, 50 ft, red
items.use: Same 18 AWG silicone lead wire as 6733-0, in red, for building custom-length leads that pair with the black reel. Not a CAT-rated lead unless every termination is CAT III-rated.
items.rating: 10,000 VDC / 20 A, hands-free testing in a controlled voltage environment only. Not for handheld use above 30 Vrms / 42.2 Vpk / 60 Vdc or above 8 A. Datasheet says the wire will comply with CAT III, IEC 61010-031 when correctly terminated with other CAT III-rated parts. The wire alone is not a CAT-rated test lead, and no CAT voltage is stated.
field_notes: Same as the black reel: not a CAT-rated lead until every termination is CAT III-rated.
Don't hold it on live parts above 30 Vrms / 42.2 Vpk / 60 Vdc or 8 A.

items.name: Stackable double banana plug with cable guide, black
items.use: Solderless set-screw double banana plug for building 0.75 in-spaced leads or stacking connections on banana-jack instruments and fixtures. Not CAT-rated; not for handheld use above 33 Vrms / 70 Vdc.
items.rating: 15 A; 5000 Vrms max hands-free in a controlled environment; +50 °C max. Not for handheld use above 33 Vrms / 70 Vdc. No IEC CAT rating on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Official name is a stackable double banana plug with cable guide; Newark's listing called it an adaptor. Do not confuse with MDP-0# bulk packaging.
field_notes: Not CAT-rated. Don't hold it on live parts above 33 Vrms / 70 Vdc.
Good for bench and fixture hookups, not for probing energized gear by hand.

items.name: Solderless stackable banana plug with safety collar, black, 10-pack
items.use: Do-it-yourself 4 mm banana plug that clamps onto 18–22 AWG lead wire with a set screw, used to make or repair custom test leads. Not CAT-rated, so not a CAT III lead on its own.
items.rating: 15 A; 5000 Vrms max hands-free in a controlled environment; +50 °C max. Do not hold in hand above 30 Vrms / 60 Vdc. No IEC CAT rating on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Newark manufacturer part is listed as 1825-0 10PK; pack of 10. Official Pomona page lists 10 per package. Digi-Key also carries 1825-0 but sells it as individual plugs (https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/pomona-electronics/1825-0/603383), so Mouser is listed here as the 10-pack match.
field_notes: Not CAT-rated, so a lead built with it is not a CAT III lead.
Don't hold it on live parts above 30 Vrms / 60 Vdc. Not for circuits where transients can exceed its rating.

items.name: Solderless stackable banana plug with safety collar, red, 10-pack
items.use: Same do-it-yourself 4 mm banana plug as 1825-0, in red, for terminating the red lead wire on custom test leads. Not CAT-rated, so not a CAT III lead on its own.
items.rating: 15 A; 5000 Vrms max hands-free in a controlled environment; +50 °C max. Do not hold in hand above 30 Vrms / 60 Vdc. No IEC CAT rating on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Newark manufacturer part is listed as 1825-2 10PK; pack of 10. Same official page as 1825-0. Digi-Key also carries 1825-2 as individual plugs (https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/pomona-electronics/1825-2/603384).
field_notes: Not CAT-rated, so a lead built with it is not a CAT III lead.
Don't hold it on live parts above 30 Vrms / 60 Vdc. Not for circuits where transients can exceed its rating.

items.name: Medium alligator clip set for 4 mm sheathed banana plugs, red/black pair
items.use: Snaps onto 4 mm sheathed DMM test leads so a tech can clip onto terminals and hardware up to 0.3 in (7.6 mm). CAT rating covers the clip only; leads, plugs and meter must also be rated for the circuit.
items.rating: IEC 61010-031, 1000 V CAT II / 600 V CAT III, 10 A; −20 to 55 °C; pollution degree 2, 2000 m.
items.notes: Official model is 5916B; Newark lists 5916B/POM. Pack is one black and one red clip (pack of 2), not a 10-pack. Accepts 4 mm sheathed safety banana plugs (Pomona cites 5907A/5908A/5909A).
field_notes: The only CAT-rated clip in this list: 1000 V CAT II / 600 V CAT III, 10 A.
The rating covers the clip only. Leads, plugs and meter must also be rated for the circuit.

items.name: Alligator clip with banana jack and flex boot, black, 10-pack
items.use: Takes a banana-plug patch cord in the jack so the clip can grab terminals and hardware up to 0.300 in (7.62 mm). Not CAT-rated and limited to 150 Vrms; not for energized power circuits. Use 5916B for CAT-rated work.
items.rating: 150 Vrms, 5 A max, +50 °C max. No IEC CAT rating on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Official datasheet: sold in packages of 10 per color. These are not CAT-rated, unlike 5916B. Newark's page labels this '72924 Series,' which does not appear on the official Pomona datasheet or product page (model is 2240).
field_notes: Only 150 Vrms / 5 A and not CAT-rated. Not for 208/480 V or any energized power circuit.
Use 5916B when you need a CAT-rated clip.

items.name: Banana jack to #8–#10 spade lug adapter, red/black set
items.use: Converts a banana-plug lead to a bare-metal spade lug for #8 or #10 screw terminals and binding posts. No handheld, AC or CAT rating, so use only on de-energized or low-voltage test setups.
items.rating: 5000 VDC, 15 A, +50 °C max. No handheld limit, AC rating or CAT rating stated on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Official product page lists 3777A-02 as a set of one black and one red ('Banana Jack/Spade Lug 8-10'). The official datasheet's ordering table is an image ('see table above'); color and #8–#10 size are taken from that official product-page model list.
field_notes: No handheld, AC or CAT rating. Bare-metal spade lug.
Land it on de-energized terminals, or low-voltage test setups only.

items.name: Banana jack to 1.6 mm (.063 in) pin-tip adapter, black
items.use: Banana jack on one end accepts a standard banana plug; the other end is a 0.063 in (1.60 mm) male pin that plugs into a matching 16-size socket contact on a multi-pin connector. Low-voltage connector testing only; not for energized power circuits.
items.rating: 3 A. Do not hold in hand above 33 Vrms / 70 Vdc; 2500 Vrms max hands-free; +55 °C max. No IEC CAT rating on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Official datasheet groups models 3561/3563/3565/4691; 3563 is the 16 AWG / 0.063 in (1.60 mm) pin. Official product-page title says 'Banana Plug Test Adapter,' but the banana end is a jack that accepts a banana plug. Newark lists 13 A / 2.5 kV, which conflicts with the official 3 A / 2500 Vrms hands-free figures; official datasheet used here.
field_notes: Only 3 A. Don't hold it on live parts above 33 Vrms / 70 Vdc.
Low-voltage connector testing only, not for energized power circuits.
